notes.title: Skogdal Major Update 1 - version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Out first major update is finally live!

For this update we have gone through all the feedback we have gotten. We hope the changes manages to fix issues you have had, and change the game for the better, also some new content!



[b]Game Difficulty:[/b]
We have gotten a lot of feedback regarding the game's difficulty. Many players have reported the game being too difficult, and feeling frustration regarding playing the first runs over and over again as they are not able to progress the game. Our vision has always been for the game to be challenging, but not appear to be only for the most hardcore (card game) players out there! With this update, we have added a whole new feature to help address this, in addition to some minor balance tweaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/3dff930fdf2687c03f5b063465e6cd6a0ed10566.png[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Feature: Player lives,[/b] for any given run, you now have 3 lives - when you die, you can retry from the start of the last location you reached. Our goal with this feature is to give you multiple chances against the most difficult enemies, to help alleviate against the frustration of reaching the end of a long run, only to die against an enemy you have never faced and were unprepared against. We believe this also gives creates fun tension, with a few more shots at making it, and also more forgiving towards player's time. Still, if your deck is simply not good enough, you likely won't make it regardless.
[*][b]New playable character/skin: Bat Man[/b], unlocked by getting a couple of proper game overs, or alternatively reaching late game, has a powerful starting deck that should kickstart you into winning runs!
[*][b]Buffed fuses Double Punch[/b] and [b]Double Block[/b], making you generally slightly stronger late in runs.
[*]Buffed Punker follower, as it was maybe too niche, now he also gives block when sacrificed, to support more builds.
[*][b]Buffed gain health upgrade[/b] every fight from 3 to 4, to make this a more attractive option.
[*][b]New card fuse[/b]: [b]Coffee with Milk[/b].
[*][b]New follower: Rockstar[/b]. Funny story, I did an error when I implemented the original release character, as me and my brother kept talking abouta follower we wanted to have: Rockman/Blockman, I thought we were talking about a big buff "The Rock character", while my brother was thinking Rockman -> Rockstar. Anyhow, now we have both!
[*]Updated Crib starting drafts, after completing the first run, now you get to choose between 3 card bundles instead of 2, and after completing the second run, you get to choose between 4 followers for best friend. Making it more likely to get started with an interesting deck.
[*]Added credits for localization team.
[*]Added a missing transformation effect for a certain boss (HM).
[*]Adjusted card unlocks, some cards appear earlier, and made final milestones much faster (the final ones were way too slow and grindy).
[*]Made booster pack opening even more awesome (yes, we HAVE played Vampire Survivors)!
[*]Improved tooltips for location clues (HM).
[*]Improved visual effects for certain followers and cards, for example: Wrestler, Yuppie and Die Roll.
[*]Fixed a few more typos.
[*]Fixed mouse scroll for character grid.
[*]Fixed a bug where players would wrongly unlock the secret character.
[*]Fixed a bug with Prayer, where you sometimes couldn't revive, even if you should.
[*]Fixed a bug with Card Sleeves and cards that returns cards from removed pile.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/65868bb115aca024a78ea98b700dea5b1d3031c8.png[/img]

Let us know if this update has broken anything!
Thank you everyone for the great feedback, and for playing the game. Rock on!

notes.title: Demo Update 06. June 2024
notes.content:
Hello Skogdal, has been a while since the last update (time is moving slower out here in this rustic small town).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/fbcbaca728cdb215fbbc51654fc3ada1f70beea9.png[/img]
We got a lot of fixes and improvements for the demo, so let's get right to it:
[list]
[*]Improved tooltips, now the tooltip text boxes appears above cards, instead of the old (quick fix) of having them appear in the corner, this feels much better, looks more polished and makes the game much more readable, getting the information where the cards are.
[*]Improvements to various aspect ratios, ensuring the game looks better at various non-standard aspect ratios.
[*]Updated the final location background image (my brother notified me that this should be a big picture ;) all the more details to study whatever is going on there...)
[*]Updated some drafts to only include "object" cards, for example in the Trash draft, as it doesn't (necessarily) make sense to find a Follower, or a "Annoying Whistle" in the trash can. Same with some characters who now only let's you draft "cool moves".
[*]Renamed "Get" to "Create" new cards, there was some confusion on a few edge cases, especially what counts as getting cards vs. drawing cards, and now it should be more clear on what effects "Create" new cards for a fight.
[*]Various minor fixes and game balancing: Arm Wrestler has a ceiling to how much Strength he gives, Girl in Wheelchair was missing sound effects, renamed "Bonus Damage" to "Temporary Strength" (and also in case there will be some cross synergy there in the future), various text updates, "Joker" card now only improves "Rage" and does it better, improved "Tobacco" (but remember smoking is bad) and tweaked Scooter girl enemy, a bit more difficult now.
[/list]



My brother recently recorded a mini devlog/video podcast on youtube, introducing himself as the game's artist, and his background in gaming, very worth checking out:
[previewyoutube=XF5C4Z_Nomg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Update 06. February 2024
notes.content:
We originally planned to wait until we have more content for the next update, but since Steam Next Fest has started (we are not officially part of it), we are still getting more visitors to Skogdal. With that, we figured we could push a new update.

We have new cards, balancing and some fixes today, then in a couple of weeks, we will bring the [b]BIG[/b] demo update ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/8ec936dae5f162a639a96c495bfd67b4a73f47ff.jpg[/img]

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*]New cards along with tons of new card mechanics, as highlighted in the art below.
[*]A big pass on card balancing and card changes, we have moved a few cards around to make sure "themes" fit better. Looking at you Mystery Pills, with inspiration from a certain action roguelike...
[*]Changed Burn, this might get an balance pass with the next update. Burn now lasts 2 turns, and deals X damage per turn. If you apply more burn while burn is already active, duration is reset and damage increased. Our goal is to make Burn sustained damage over time, but with the condition that you continually have to stoke the flames.
[*]Fixed some typos and text issues.
[*]Added hint to cards you draft, if you already have a card it can Fuse with.
[*]Other misc fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/52d9464116098e4490f50b0b239943daabc75713.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/1e995f0d9977d9c4aef0e3be575d334912a6f57d.jpg[/img]

The next update will contain new locations to visit along the run featured in the demo, along with even more cards and fixes!

notes.title: Demo Update 26. January 2024
notes.content:
What's new in Skogdal?

We made a big update to the demo. We are planning a new big update in a few weeks, which will add new locations and lots of new cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/933288c8445fdaea9b9e9ec7d02ba8c59f952fd3.jpg[/img]

In this update, we got one big new change, and then multiple smaller fixes and new cards:

[b]BIG:[/b] we added a new feature to the drawing mechanic of the game. Now you can pay energy to draw additional cards, the first time you activate it in a turn, it cost 1, then 2, 3 etc. We also included a toggle that let's you automatically spend remaining energy to draw cards, when you end your turn. This has been the aspect of the game we have gotten the most feedback on so far, as it is boring to get stuck in the scenarios where you only draw 1 card every turn. For us, we want to keep the design of drawing cards more similar to traditional card games, rather than the more typical roguelike deckbuilder approach of a new hand of cards every turn, as it both forces us to design the game a bit differently, and it also leads to different dynamics. The skill of building a deck that handles cards as a resource is also an interesting aspect we like. We feel this solution both fixes the issues that has been flagged, while maintaining our vision for the game!

Added new cards to the game, as you can see in images here. One major inclusion here, is more cards to support a Bleed strategy. We also added a few more experimental cards, now we're starting to get into the groove of more unique cards for our game (a lot more juicy cards to be added in the next update)!

Improved tooltips, among this tooltip and card previews to enemy intended actions.

Lot's of minor fixes and adjustments, among these: 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where spray effect on cards would sometimes be applied also to newly generated cards after affect had been applied.
[*]More variations to guitar riffs sound effects.
[*]Text updates and fixed some typos.
[*]Preview of source cards in card tooltip view (left click), for cards created by other cards or fused from other cards.
[*]Fixed visual glitches when camera shakes.
[*]Fixed bug where sometimes cards would have different inconsistent sizes in hand.
[*]And a lot more
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/8b0133883602d6ddfe8302c7b4025f955b6600ad.jpg[/img]

Thank you everyone who has tested the game and given us feedback!

notes.title: DevBlog 17.August 2023
notes.content:
Hello fellow card gamers, this is our first of several developer blog posts for Skogdal. We want to show you a little bit of what we are currently working on, and how progress on the game is going.



Since we first made our Steam page public a couple of months ago, we have mainly been working on adding more content to the game, supporting more advanced gameplay mechanics and also of course making new art, both location background art pieces, and characters and card art.



[u]Some of the highlights of what we have been working on are:[/u]
- Fuse cards draft event (certain combinations of cards can be fused together to make a completely new card), an example of this is [b]"Flamethrower"[/b], which is a card made up of [b]"Deodorant"[/b] and [b]"Zippo"[/b], we try to have these combinations both make sense from real world experiences and also to be fun for the player to discover:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/b4c3ba6cfaa0481d6e8df4fcc8dc3c8c5e831b32.jpg[/img]
- Support for discard effects, discarding cards from your hand.
- Card removal events.
- More status effects.
- More advanced enemy behaviours, now having enemies that build up Strength during the fight etc.
- More interesting follower cards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/1a7f2352f843849e4f5239774e13f56919b6d99a.jpg[/img]
- New locations (we can't show these yet, but trust me, they look great).
- Card art!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/6d94403bab863c2baffba167d20871af70a20d5a.jpg[/img]



[b]Gamescom 2023[/b]
We will be present at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany next week. We are visiting the business area, and not the public area, as part of a Nordic group having a stand together. Our goal is to meet with potential publishers or funding partners for the game, and in general see what other people in the business thinks of our game. Getting a publisher is not a must-have, but if we find the right partnership, it would definitely be a benefit for us, to have someone help with marketing, funding etc. 
[i]Btw. we also made some really cool business cards for the event (I think we might have the coolest ones there):[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/45223439d3db6c6eba30644f4c2e49ed4e7f605b.jpg[/img]



[b]The future[/b]
As you can see on our Steam page, we plan to release Skogdal during 2024. That is still far off, but we do want to have players test our game before that, getting hands on feedback is important for a game like this, along with building a community. We are working towards a Steam demo later this fall, and when we release that, we will also probably make a Discord server for the game, so watch out for news about that when we are getting closer to it!



See you in next blog post, in the meantime, enjoy some pizza:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273925/7b620ee91a019e458969f895afbb39d85d447e40.jpg[/img]
